title: Why Is There a Hole in Airplane Windows?
description:
There is a hole in your airplane window. There are tiny fins on the wing, little sticks on the tail, and a spiral painted on the engine. There is an ashtray in a bathroom where smoking has been banned for decades. You have seen all of them. Almost nobody can explain them. Today we are going to explain twelve of them, and one of these parts was the reason a whole generation of jets fell out of the sky.

Machine Reverse takes apart the machines you see every day and explains, part by part, why each one exists. This video covers 12 parts.

Chapters:
0:00 Intro
1:25 1. The hole in your window
3:03 2. The round windows
4:48 3. The tiny fins on the wing
6:26 4. The sticks on the wingtips
8:05 5. The bent wingtips
9:46 6. The canoes under the wing
11:18 7. The teeth on the engine
12:52 8. The spiral on the engine
14:26 9. The little tube on the nose
16:06 10. The hidden propeller
17:44 11. The triangle above your seat
18:49 12. The ashtray in the bathroom
20:03 The verdict
